title: IS Three d Power Doppler of the Endometrial and Subendometrial Regions Effective in Predicting Endometrial Implantation?
brief_summary: Three D power Doppler US was done for every woman at the day after HCG administration. Ovum pick up was done after 35 hours following HCG administration. The luteal phase was supported by progesterone 300 mg per day (progest, micronized progesterone 100mg, Technopharma, Egypt, for pharco pharmaceuticals, Amriya- Alexandria). Five days following ovum pick up, the embryos were transferred at the blastocyst stage.
